thread:
noah: Design request for Apr launch/webinar inbound — want modular benchmark tiles that can be A/B tested in social and email. Scope: hero bench for the webinar, 4 modular tiles (each highlights a different tradeoff), 3 social templates (IG/LI/X) + animated sparkline, an email hero + two subject-line variants, and sales one-pager hero for SDRs. Deadline: static comps by Mon noon PT.

ivy: Sounds good. Quick clarifiers: what are the tile sizes and grid specs? And do tiles need alternate copy blocks for AB?

noah: Tiles should be square 600px, smaller 300px for in-email modules. Each tile needs two copy variants (long + short) for A/B. Also request tracking-friendly CTA button area to include UTM.

samir: For the benchmark hero, recommend a 1600x900 scatter (cost_per_1000 x p95_ms) with 3 highlighted tiles pointing to different clusters. Keep annotations qualitative: "lower-cost", "better tail latency". No quantitative claims.

claire: Brand/legal: use approved type scale and neutral canvas for charts. Footer lockup text: "Redwood Inference  production-ready inference" and source: "internal benchmark; illustrative". Pass AA contrast for text and CTAs.

ivy: Deliverables list I'm tracking:
- herobench_1600x900_static.svg/png/jpg
- modular_tile_600x600_variantA/variantB (4 tiles)
- modular_tile_300x300_email_set
- social_ig_1080x1080_static+gif, social_li_1200x627_mp4+static, social_x_800x450_static+gif
- email_hero_600x200 + two subject line options
- sales_onepager_hero_1200x628 for SDR decks
- exports: SVG for web, PNG for email, optimized GIF/MP4 for socials

samir: Metrics CSV link: https://drive.redwood/bench/2026-apr-tiles.csv (fields: model,cost_per_1000,p95_ms,tokens_sec). We'll flag any p95 > 2200ms as outliers.

claire: Legal note: no dollar savings or SLA claims in any copy. Keep annotations descriptive. I'll run a quick sweep after first comps. Also request alt text for each asset and a short clip description for animated cards.

noah: AB notes: Marketing will run two CTA wordings: "Try a demo" vs "See a walkthrough". Add UTM placeholder zone in the CTA so we can swap links without re-exporting.

ivy: Animation note: sparkline loop 10 frames, very subtle, target GIF <1.8MB for IG. Provide MP4 fallback for LinkedIn. We'll also provide an animated Lottie-friendly JSON where possible.

assets-bot: Reminder: use naming convention MIQ_abbench2026_{asset}_{channel}_{variant}. Example: MIQ_abbench2026_tile600_variantA. Tag Figma frames: release/ab-bench-inbound/2026-04-14 for automated export.

samir: I'll post final CSV + cleaned metrics by 5pm PT today. Noah, will you own subject lines for the email AB?

noah: Yes, will post subject-line options in 30m. Ivy, can you share initial comps by 10:30 PT?

ivy: Yes — static comps by 10:30 PT, animated cards by Thu EOD, final exports Fri morning. Will include alt text drafts in Figma.

claire: Great. After comps we9ll do a fast brand/legal pass and then hand off to growth for AB setup. Thanks team :rocket:
